title: Introducing MolScope: lightweight molecular structure analysis in Python
excerpt: A small Python toolkit for reading PDB, mmCIF, XYZ and SDF files, computing descriptors, exporting graphs to PyTorch Geometric, and prototyping coarse-grained mappings, without dragging in a whole ecosystem.

title: Building ContractsDB Agent: the 80% that wasn't the LLM

title: Martini 3 Coarse-Grained Force Field
excerpt: An in-depth look at the Martini 3 coarse-grained force field, its advancements, and diverse applications in molecular dynamics simulations.

title: Use of position restraint in Molecular Dynamics Simulation
excerpt: Position restraints keep delicate protein structures intact during the early stages of MD equilibration, letting extreme velocities relax safely.
